list.detailedDescription: The vast majority of cloud applications written today contain some set of external dependencies. Security issues in these dependencies can make applications using them insecure. The Log4J crisis is one example of this. SCA (Software Composition Analysis) scanning is the most basic way of determining if an application is using vulnerable dependencies.

list.detailedDescription: SAST (Static Application Security Testing) applications are the most basic type of security vulnerability detection applications that an organization should use. From SQL injections to cross-site scripting SAST applications are a basic requirement to stop easily preventable issues from making their way to production.
